comments.author: @dondobbs9302
comments.text: Don't know why it took me 4 years to see this but it's spot on. After living in C.M. for like 15 years, I'd say this video is on point for recommendations. A caveat for people on a lower budget and/or not renting an auto; a lot of these places are pretty far out of town and Kiti Panit is pretty 'Hi-So' You'll be dropping well over a thousand BHT there. You can get almost everything listed here within "the square" of old town Chiang Mai. I'd say; Laab Kai Meuang Phan Waen for Laab and other more exotic Lanna dishes, Huen Phen for the same but a bit more tame, Kanom Jeen Pa Pom for it's signature dish and the Khao Soi is world class. Yes; the markets he lists are the best, a Song Thaow loop will take you to both. + Krua Phech Doi Ngam that he has above is just out of town center on Mahidol rd and the Sai Uua grill is just up the road, across the bridge.
